definitions.explanation: Describes prices or costs that are shockingly high. An emphatic, informal expression stronger than simply 高い.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{激高|げきたか}だ。
⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{激高|げきたか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was shocked at the sky-high repair cost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{激高|げきたか}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{停|と}めよう。
examples.english: The parking lot in front of the station is outrageously expensive, so let's park somewhere a bit farther away.

notes:
Composed of {激|げき} (extreme, intense) + {高|たか} (high, expensive). An informal, emphatic expression used to describe prices that feel shockingly high. Part of a productive pattern where {激|げき} intensifies adjectives.

The {激|げき}〜 INTENSIFIER PATTERN:
- ⟦{激安|げきやす}→激安：13373_gekiyasu⟧: dirt cheap
- {激高|げきたか}: sky-high expensive
- ⟦{激辛|げきから}→激辛：19465_gekikara⟧: extremely spicy
- {激甘|げきあま}: extremely sweet
- {激混|げきこ}み: extremely crowded
- {激レア|げきれあ}: extremely rare

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激高|げきたか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: an extremely expensive shop
- {激高|げきたか}な⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: outrageously high fees
- {激高|げきたか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧: so expensive one can't afford it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧: high price — neutral, formal term for a large monetary amount
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: expensive — the standard adjective, without the emphatic shock value
- ⟦{法外|ほうがい}→法外：20324_hougai⟧: exorbitant — formal; implies the price is unreasonably or unjustly high
